text: __NOTOC__ Skymaster Baeric is a blood elf flight master located at Sunreaver's Command in Crystalsong Forest. Two large Sunreaver Dragonhawks are found beside him.

The Skyreach Pillar is located in southeast Sholazar Basin. Like the Glimmering Pillar, Mosslight Pillar and Suntouched Pillar, it is a tall, narrow butt that rises up from the relatively flat basin floor, with a thin, elongated device hovering over it, swirling with magic. Blue crystals grow out of its sides, and the Frenzyheart Tribe lives in its shadow. At the time of the war against the Lich King, adventurers were sent by Oracle Soo-nee to use the Didgeridoo of Contemplation atop this pillar. High-Shaman Rakjak of the Frenzyheart Tribe also sent them to gather Skyreach Crystal Cluster around the base and south of the pillar. To the northwest, Pitch could sometimes be found in the Wildgro
__NOTOC__ Skymaster Skyles is a blood elf flight master located at Falconwing Square in Eversong Woods.
__NOTOC__ Skymaster Brightdawn is the blood elf flight master located at Fairbreeze Village in Eversong Woods.
Skyfall Stars are seen during the Asaad encounter in Vortex Pinnacle.
Sky Dancer Ji is a pandaren flight master located at Serpent's Overlook in the Jade Forest.
Skyfire Marines are humans standing guard aboard the Skyfire in Stormwind City. They are later found in the Jade Forest. They are also present at the Cove of Nashal.

__NOTOC__ Skyscreamers (also known as pterodactyls and pterrorwings) are large, flying pterosaurs found on the Isle of Giants. Many of them were tamed by the Zandalari trolls and brought to the Isle of Thunder to be used as aerial companions and mounts during their conflict with the Alliance and Horde. Skyscreamers are immune to lightning. During the Zandalari Troll Wars, the Zandalari employed a form of warfare none had ever seen, descending into battle on the backs of pterrorwings and giant bats. The pandaren had no counter to these aerial attacks until the founding of the Order of the Cloud Serpent.
The Sky Golem summons a flying shredder mount. It resembles the armor of Siegecrafter Blackfuse.
Skunky Brew is an ability used by Skunky Alemental during a Pet Battle.
The Skymesa Palisade is a building on the southeastern side of the Sha'tari Skymesa overlooking . This overlook also provides the elevator between the skymesa and the Shattrath City Center.

__NOTOC__ Skyguard Thann is a draenei located at Lion's Watch in Tanaan Jungle. He is involved in the Alliance offensive against Gul'dan's Iron Horde. He is the flight master for Lion's Watch and tends to their gryphons.
__NOTOC__ Skyguard Blann is the flight master located at The Iron Front in the Tanaan Jungle.

, the most sacred artifact of the tribe.]] The Skyhorn tribe is one of the four tribes of the Highmountain tauren, led by Lasan Skyhorn. They are a proud people: their tribe sports some of the greatest pathfinders and hunters Azeroth has ever known. The Skyhorn are masters of the skies. Much like the Frostborn dwarves of the Storm Peaks, they ride on enormous eagles which allows them to reach areas that no other tauren can. This has also caused them to become more dominant than the Rivermane and Bloodtotem, which in turn has caused tension with the latter tribe. The Skyhorn's totem animal is an eagle. __NOTOC__ The Skyhorn Nestling is rewarded from Empty Nest in Highmountain.
Skyfire Deck Guns are located on the Skyfire above Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City and above the Cove of Nashal.
Skyfire Gryphons are gryphons located in Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City and at the Cove of Nashal. They are tended by Skyfire Gryphon Riders.
Skyguard Aces are humans, dwarves, Broken, and blood elves briefly appearing in Terokk's Rest in Terokkar Forest. They assisted the adventurers in defeating Terokk.
__NOTOC__ Skycaller Drez'mal is a man'ari eredar located in Highmountain during the Legion Assaults.
Skyfire Gyrocopter Pilots are humans located in Stormwind City, the Jade Forest, Krasarang Wilds, and Stormheim. They ride Skyfire Gyrocopters.
Skyguard Engineers were engineers located aboard the Skyguard gunship flying above the sundered Silithus.

Skyhorn Eagles are eagles located on the Gates of Orgrimmar in Orgrimmar during The Stormwind Extraction. They carried the Horde agents into Stormwind City and assisted them in escape. Then they can be seen in Dazar'alor. One is seen with Lasa the Galerider‎.
Skyripper Hunters are flayedwings located at a lake hidden in the mountains in southern Maldraxxus.
Skyripper Fledglings are flayedwings located at a lake hidden in the mountains in southern Maldraxxus.
Skur the Unbroken is an ogre located in Molten Cay during Island Expeditions.
Skullspike Devastators are located at the Path of Understanding in Korthia.
Skybreaker's Fiery Demise is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Demise of Skybreaker.
Skygazer Paatu is a tuskarr flight master located in Iskaara in the Azure Span. Paa is found next to her.
__NOTOC__ Skybreaker Transport is a flying troop transport with a Skybreaker Suppression Turret attached on the front. This vehicle can be found in the Valley of Lost Hope of Icecrown.
Skyfeather Matriarch is a gryphon who flies back and forth to two cliff ledges, pausing on one for a minute before flying back to the other, above Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus.

Sky-Captain Bomblast commands The Iron Eagle, the zeppelin that runs between Orgrimmar and Grom'gol Base Camp. He runs the tightest airship in all of Azeroth, which might explain only one female goblin aboard. He claims the airship used to be fitted with twin light cannons and enough bombs to flatten a city, that her mere shadow was enough to rout armies. Brassbolts would say otherwise.
__NOTOC__ Slam is a level 1 warrior ability that instantly deals damage to a target.

The Slaughtered Lamb is a seedy pub in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind City. The top floor is empty except for the bartender Jarel Moor, which advises patrons to "stay away from the shadows". Beneath the pub, the basement and catacombs serve as host to the warlocks of Stormwind, they are used as training grounds for new recruits in the kingdom, and for transferred students from Khaz Modan. Within the hidden enclave, the warlock community study and practice the dark arts, sheltered from the rest of the population. Among the warlock masters, Demisette Cloyce is one of the oldest and most respected members of their circle, while Spackle Thornberry was once in charge of selling demonic grimoires t

__NOTOC__ Slavering Ghouls are ghouls found in the Western Plaguelands. Once human subjects of Lordaeron, Slavering Ghouls are one of the basic footsoldiers of the Scourge. Located at both Sorrow Hill and Felstone Field, they are a popular quarry of both Alliance and Horde players. In addition to their close proximity to the Alliance flight path in Chillwind Camp, they drop Minion Scourgestones and runecloth which can be turned in for Argent Dawn or Alliance reputation respectively. When engaged in combat, they are commonly encountered along with Skeletal Flayers.
Slaughter Hollow is an ogre mound deep in the Alterac Mountains home to the Crushridge ogres.
Slavering Ember Worgs are worgs found in the Burning Steppes prior to the Shattering.

Slag Watch is a small spire that overlooks the Deathforge in central Shadowmoon Valley. This tower holds two orcs who give out quests for Horde players. Deathforge Tower, a similar structure for Alliance, stands just south of here.
Slamshot Shoulders are a pair of Level 55 quality Plate Shoulders that improve Strength, Stamina and Haste.
The Sleepers' Key can be found in the Sleepers' Cache in the Talon Den in Stonetalon Mountains. You will need to have the Gatekeeper's Key in order to open the cache.

The warrior ability Slam together with the tier 5 (20 points required) Fury talent Improved Slam (Classic) allow warriors to set up a rather intricate "spell rotation" which can result in very high DPS. To get this rotation up and running requires some learning effort, and is for the serious gamers only, but it results in very high damage in PvE as in PvP. First a list of restrictions and points to be aware of: *In PvP, opponents frequently run in circles. Spinning around to face them will not cancel out Slam, moving to follow them will. *If a slam misses by facing the wrong way it will still cost Rage Quartz or another cast time bar addon helps greatly when trying to make this work. Slaughter Square is located deep in Stratholme's Service Entrance part of the city, and is the location of the Slaughter House. The square is full of abominations which defend their master, Lord Aurius Rivendare, from intruders. Access to the square is reached by the Gauntlet, where all the three ziggurats must be shut down in order to open the Slaughter Square portcullis. The Bayberry Inn is located here.
.]] The Sleepers' Cache can be found in the Talon Den in Stonetalon Mountains.
__NOTOC__ Sleeby is a kobold that could be found following the mountain giant Fozruk in the Arathi Highlands. As of Battle for Azeroth, he now follows Fozruk's son, also named Fozruk.

The Skytower (or The Sky Tower) was the name for the Horde flight point tower located in Orgrimmar, also linking to the Valley of Spirits. It was held and maintained by Doras, the Wind Rider. Some Orc and Troll Commoners may dwell here during holidays. A zeppelin is also tied to the Skytower.

The final working version of the Skystrider. Built by Bingles Blastenheimer and piloted by his son Ando Blastenheimer. Is used in the quest The Winds of Loch Modan to get the player to Algaz Station. The trip is its maiden flight.
The Slagworks is a foundry southeast of Baradin Hold on Tol Barad. Horde and Alliance forces will battle over it to gain control of the island.
Sleeping Gas is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
__NOTOC__ Skywisp Moth are captureable critters found flying all around the Timeless Isle.
Sleek Pelt drops from Shadowmoon Stalkers and Shaded Plainstalkers in .

Slave's Stash is found on top of an awning at in the Sootstained Mining Camp in Frostfire Ridge. Access it by jumping on top of the building to the right of it, running up the wooden plank to the rock outcrop, jumping to the next-higher-up building, and then to the building with the awning on it. Looting the stash rewards 3x Half Empty Bottle of Prison Moonshine and 25-30x Garrison Resources.
Skytalon Inuz is an arakkoa flight master located in Talador.
Slayer of the Shadowmoon is the first mission of the Horde campaign in Warcraft II: Beyond the Dark Portal.
Skytalon Kariz is an arakkoa flight master located at the Aktar's Post‎ in Tanaan Jungle.
Skytalon Meshaal is an arakkoa flight master located at the Veil Terokk in Spires of Arak.
Skytalon Kuris is an arakkoa flight master located at the Veil Akraz in the Spires of Arak.
Skytalon Karaz is an arakkoa flight master located at the Sethekk Hollow in Spires of Arak.

__NOTOC__ The Sleeper's Barrow is a barrow den found in the Steelclaw Vale of Val'sharah. Archdruid Koda Steelclaw and her disciples use this dwelling to observe and keep watch over the Emerald Dream. Unfortunately, dark intentions crept into the halls of the barrow. The satyr Morphael and his henchmen sought to corrupt the druid's sleep and intended them to never awaken. However, the malediction is halted and the watchers are able to recover. The barrow's halls are winding and filled with beautiful magics. Many of the druids' sleeping areas line the halls.

__NOTOC__ The Slave Enclave is the rear section of Neltharion's Vault in Highmountain. It is an abandoned drogbar village, with a look similar to the Maw of Neltharion, that leads to Obsidian Overlook.
Slain Guards are several deceased human located in Gilneas City. Two are located in the Merchant Square next to the body of Lieutenant Walden, more are found on top of Stoneward Prison.
The Skywhisker tribe is a group of kobolds inhabiting Highmountain. They allied with the Crawliac harpies.

The Slatecrusher are a group of drogbar. They have burrowed their way out of the hills of Suramar and were causing structural instability to the buildings in the area. Garvrulg, an exile of the group, is also located in Suramar.
Sleeping Patron are located in Southport and Axefall in the Spires of Arak. They are an orc, blood elf, human footman and dwarf mountaineer.

Slain Vulpera are vulpera corpses strewn about Shatterstone Harbor in Vol'dun prior to the Alliance's takeover of the port. They can only be seen by Alliance players that have yet to complete Ooh Rah!.
Sleepless Interrogator is a human servant of N'Zoth located on the Blackrock Mountain. He is interrogating a Blacktalon Watcher.

Slatecrusher Raiders ae drogbar who accompanied Drog Almighty and burrowed their way out of the hills of Suramar, causing structural instability to the buildings in the area. In response, the were taken out by class order champions.
Sleepless Operatives are humans located in Blackrock Mountain and Deadwind Pass.
Slappy is a mechanical crawling hand located on Mechagon Island.
__NOTOC__ Skywhisker Loyalists are kobolds located in Highmountain.
Slayer's Ultimatum is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Slaughter Sling is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Slayer's Cypher is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Slayer's Gift is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Slayer's Invocation is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Slayer's Mythos is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Slayer's Lesson is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Slayer's Cypher is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Skyward Ascent is a dracthyr racial ability. It is only available while using Soar.
__NOTOC__ Skytop Observatory is located in the southwestern Waking Shores atop a mountain. Dragonriding facilities can be found there such as the Rostrum of Transformation.

The Skyward Watch lies north of the Shrouded Coast of the Caldera of the Menders in northwestern Forbidden Reach. The island is occupied by Menial Attendants and Amberfur Slyvern. The rare Ishyra, the Maiden of Discernment, keeps her watch here overlooking the Shrouded Coast. A Bronze Timekeeper starts the "Caldera Coaster" dragonriding race in a protected spot immediately below where Ishyra spawns. A Forbidden Hoard occasionally spawns at inside the tower guarded by five Refti Confiscators.

__NOTOC__ Slice and Dice is a level 9 rogue ability. It is a finishing move that makes quick work of enemies by allowing you to attack more quickly than usual. By increasing the speed of your auto attacks, it also allows more poison applications within a given time frame.

Sludge-Covered Object is dropped from Black Bloods of Draenor and Draenor Blood Terrors in the Netherwing Mines of Shadowmoon Valley. After achieving reputation with Netherwing and completing the quest The Netherwing Mines, Sludge-Covered Objects have a substantial chance of containing the Murkblood Escape Plans, which start the quest The Great Murkblood Revolt.

in Warcraft III: Reforged.]] Sludge beasts, also known as sludge monsters, are the oozes of Warcraft III. These strange creatures share an elemental heritage but have been corrupted by the powers of chaos. Now they exist as tortured masses of semi-sapient goo. No one knows what their motivations are or if there is any specific ecology behind their existence. They are noted to be native to Kalimdor.
Slicing Claw can be purchased for from: * in Durotar * in Teldrassil * in Dun Morogh * in Shattrath City
The slith is a serpentine form assumed by troll prophets and high priests drawing their powers from the great serpent loa Hethiss and Sseratus.
Slitherblade Shore is an area encompassing the shores near Ethel Rethor in Desolace. This include a newly risen island with night elven ruins from where a naga priestess commands the Slitherblade.

The Sludgewerks is a small Horde base built near a wyvern habitat on the shores of Mirkfallon Lake in Stonetalon Mountains. Initially designed to not do any harm to the wyvern, the goblins that run the platform have had the misfortune of dealing with the droppings of the local wyvern because of this design and location.
__NOTOC__ Slingtail Stickypaws are hozen found at Moonwater Retreat in the Jade Forest.
Slicing Wind is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Slippery Ice is an ability used mainly by penguins during a Pet Battle.
Slick Dropdip is a goblin flight master located at Bootlegger Outpost in Tanaris.
The Slime Coated Kingscloak is a cloak that gives a bonus to Strength and Stamina.
Slrglrglr "Stabby" Glrslrslr is a murloc located at the Trueshot Lodge in Highmountain. He is sparring with Gharset the Aimtrue. He also appeared in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore.

Sloppy "Sloppy Joe" Joe is a human captive found in the northern part of Shipwreck Cove in Highmountain. Upon freeing him, the following occurs: : :Mrrklr spawns in the distance and begins running towards the player. : : :Joe runs away and despawns.
Slumber is a bear vignette found sleeping in the center of the Witchwood in Highmountain.
Slithering Brownscales are snakes found in Stormheim, Azsuna, Highmountain, and Tiragarde Sound.
Slumbering Mjordins are vrykul located in the Halls of the Ancestors in Icecrown. Empowered versions appeared during Death Rising.
__NOTOC__ Slime Elementals are water elementals located at the Outflow on Mechagon Island.
Slimy Sea Slug is an aquatic pet that can be looted from Slimy Cocoon in Nazjatar. This pet has all his skills 100% accurate and all of them being magic-based.
Slumbering Mountain is a night elf located in Verdant Wilds.
Sludge-Covered Minicollider is looted from Dredged Canisters on Mechagon Island.
__NOTOC__ Slitherscale is a saurok located in Island Expeditions.
The Sleetguard Greatbelt is an Island Expedition reward. The item can also be contained in Jorundall Salvage.
The Sleetguard Warboots are an Island Expedition reward. The item can also be contained in Jorundall Salvage.
Sling of the Unseen is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Slippery Wraithcoil is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Slippers of Enduring Vigilance drop from the Sisters of the Moon in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Slime-Stacked Shoulderplates are a quest reward from Oh, the Clawdacity!.
Slime-Stacked Mantle is a quest reward from Oh, the Clawdacity!.
Slime-Stacked Shoulderguards are a quest reward from Oh, the Clawdacity!.
Slime-Stacked Shoulderpads are a quest reward from Oh, the Clawdacity!.
Slick Ice is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of Slick Ice.
Slime-Covered Reins of the Hulking Deathroc summons a Hulking Deathroc, a deathroc flying mount. This item drops from Violet Mistake in the House of Plagues in Maldraxxus.
__NOTOC__ Slithering Swampserpents are serpents located in the Blind Marshlands in Highmountain.

Smokywood Pastures is the name of a goblin business. They are most prominent during the Feast of Winter Veil selling Feast of Winter Veil goods, but can also be found year-round selling food and drink outside of battlegrounds. The Copperpinch family sells primarily to the Horde, while the Jinglepocket family sells primarily to the Alliance, but in Shattrath City they share the sales. In spite of their faction specific locations, the Smokywood Pastures vendors are all , and will sell to either faction, if you can get to them.

Smoky Iron Ingots drop from the following kobolds in the Stonetalon Mountains: *Windshear Vermin *Windshear Stonecutter *Windshear Digger *Windshear Overlord *Windshear Tunnel Rat *Windshear Geomancer
__NOTOC__ Small Spider Legs drop from spiders below level 20 in Elwynn Forest, Loch Modan, Silverpine Forest, Stonetalon Mountains, Teldrassil, and Tirisfal Glades.
Smoking Heart of the Mountain is a Level 50 quality Trinket that improves Critical Strike and Versatility.
The Small Soul Pouch is a quest reward from The Binding (Succubus, Undercity).
__NOTOC__ Smith Gorlunk is a fel orc found in Shadowmoon Valley.
The Smoldering Claw is a Level 50 quality polearm that improves strength and has a chance on hit to deal additional damage.

Small Lockboxes can be found throughout the Ruins of Andorhal in the Western Plaguelands. Despite its name, this isn't a lockbox requiring special abilities or items to open; it's just a regular chest object.

Small-time Hustlers can be found standing standing on a barrel at Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm, outside the southern gate to Sentinel Hill prior to the Defias Brotherhood attack on that settlement, in Moonbrook and near the entrance to the Deadmines. They will occasionally say something to the player, possibly dependent on which stage of the Westfall storyline you are on, when approached. This is usually preceded by "Pssst." Despite solicitations to the contrary, they do not actually sell anything. Like other characters in the area, they are neutral rather than friendly toward Alliance players as a result of deteriorating conditions in Westfall and the Brotherhood's efforts under Vanessa VanCleef
Small Rocks are acquired when using the Pimento's Stomp ability during the quest The Ballad of Maximillian. They are your only defense against the charging Devilsaur Queen.
Smash is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Smelly Mountaintop is a grummle located at Neverest Basecamp in Kun-Lai Summit.
Small Azerite Cluster can be obtained from multiple sources: *a quest reward from Infusing the Heart *War Campaign missions *World quests *Normal Island Expeditions (150x)
The Smoldering Bundle of Star Moss is provided as an objective for
Smiles Cracklekey is a Mechagon mechagnome located in Rustbolt on Mechagon Island. He is also encountered in Operation: Mechagon.

Small Treasure Chests can be found scattered throughout Mardum, the demon hunter starting world, and the Vault of the Wardens. Some are fairly obviously placed, but others require a bit of exploring to reach. They have a chance at containing the following: * items * * In the Broken Isles they can also contain an Artifact Power item.
Smoke Cloud is an ability used by battle pets during a Pet Battle.
Smoke Test is a dungeon & raids achievement earned by defeating Wrathion in Ny'alotha, the Waking City after defeating 10 Crackling Shards within 3 seconds of each other.
Smashmaw the Man-Eater is a bear located in Island Expeditions.
Small Smooth Spike is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Smoking Ash Pile is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Slyverns, also called fox wyverns, are flying beasts resembling large, winged foxes native to the Dragon Isles.

Smashed Transport Relay could be repaired with a Hyperbolic Circuit, a Transference Disc, and an Energy Cell, resulting in a Nullifier Transport Relay. The repaired item would then be used to summon the Mechagonian Nullifier at Junkwatt Depot on Mechagon Island.

__NOTOC__ Snarlmane Bloodgorger is a powerful gnoll not to be confused with Snarlmane both from Warcraft III Frozen Throne Expansion. He tried to stop Kael'thas from fixing the last Arcane Observatory as Lord Garithos wanted. Kael'thas slew the gnoll and reclaimed the observatory.
Snarlflare is a rare black drake located on a hill at the southwestern edge of Lake Everstill in Redridge Mountains.
Smooth Ornate Dawnstone is sold by the following vendors for : * in Stormwind City * in Orgrimmar
Smolderweb's Eye is a Level 55 quality Trinket that improves Critical Strike. It has a on-use ability that poisons it's target.
This is one of the Blasted Lands buff quests. It rewards characters with an elixir giving +25 strength for a period of 60 minutes.

Smooth Fur drops from: * Clefthoof Bull in Nagrand * Elekk Demolisher in Shadowmoon Valley * Banthar in Nagrand * Wild Elekk in Nagrand * Aged Clefthoof in Nagrand * Bull Elekk in Nagrand * Tusker in Nagrand

__NOTOC__ Smolderwing is a black drake, Brogg wish adventurers to slay the drake because of revenge due the slaughter the black dragonflight done to the Stonemaul clan. He comes forth when the adventurer places the Stonemaul Banner down in front of Onyxia's Lair.

Smotts' Revenge was a frigate belonging to Captain Hecklebury Smotts, a privateer who now runs his operations from Booty Bay. Both his first ship, as well as his second ship, aptly named Smotts' Revenge, were destroyed by a trio of sea giants — Mok'rash, Gorlash, and Negolash. It has a lifeboat which is now located on the Jaguero Isle.
Snatch is one of the pet abilities that only birds of prey can use. It has 6 ranks.

Smuggler's Scar was an empty cave in the Kelp'thar Forest, until the adventurer checked it out for Adarrah. After the rest of her surviving crew mates are rescued and brought to the cavern, the place becomes a fully functional shelter with quest givers and a blacksmith. The area also has a Swift Seahorse, the flight master for the underwater zones. Smuggler's Scar.jpg|Inside Smuggler's Scar

Deathy is a companion that was given out to attendees of BlizzCon 2010, purchasers of the DirecTV pay-per-view of the event, and purchasers of the internet streamed video of the event. Deathy is a murloc companion decked out as Deathwing, doing his best to strike fear into the hearts of Azeroth's crustacean population. Deathy is delivered by in-game mail to every character on a player's Battle.net account that has been attached to a Deathy code, much like collector's edition companions. On pulling this item out of your mailbox, you receive the Deathy (achievement) feat of strength. He will occasionally breathe smoke, and more rarely leap into the air, letting loose a burst of flame.

The Smoldering True Iron Deposit is found at in the middle of a lava pool on the southern ledge above the Daggermaw Ravine. An Ogre Wayguide is at the edge of the pool, which states: :Definitely Only Secret Lava Pool On Mountain :Stop Here This wayguide is a reference to the rare Primalist Mur'og, whose path is found to the west, marked by another wayguide at the trailhead. The vein works as regular True Iron Deposit.

The Smoldering Timewarped Ember drops by, or is looted from, the following in Timewalking difficulty: * Asaad in the Vortex Pinnacle * Erudax in Grim Batol * High Priestess Azil in the Stonecore * Siamat in Lost City of the Tol'vir * Neptulon's Cache in Throne of the Tides * Murozond's Temporal Cache in End Time

Firelord Smolderon is the Elemental Lord of fire and master of the Firelands. He had been fighting for power against Pyroth following the death of Ragnaros during the Cataclysm, until the Earthen Ring helped make him the new Firelord during the third invasion of the Burning Legion. However, shortly after becoming the Firelord, he went missing.
Smuggled Magical Supplies are a potential reward from the Class Hall missions Time Tested and Oh So Pretty. It can also be found inside Curious Wyrmtongue Cache.

__NOTOC__ Snazzle Shinyfinder is a Bluewax kobold found in Candle Rock in Highmountain during Candle of Command and Burn the Candle at Both Ends. According to Intern Jackie, Snazzle is a good worker, and he appears to be skilled at finding things. During Candle of Command, Snazzle is the first kobold to appear to be offered a job by the adventurer. During Burn the Candle at Both Ends, he is also the first to return, having found several shiny objects in the nearby burial ground.
Smuggler Nightfang was a worgen located in Highmountain in a camp along with Wrathion. He was replaced by Chofa Nighthoof.
The Snarlpaw tribe is a group of saberon based in Snarlpaw Ledge in . Their ancestors destroyed an orc village and killed Murgok and his family.

The Smoldering Reins of the Teldrassil Hippogryph teaches the Teldrassil Hippogryph, and is awarded to Alliance players who complete the Burning of Teldrassil quest chain during the War of the Thorns world event. Players who acquire this mount also earn the Horde equivalent, the War-Torn Reins of the Undercity Plaguebat.
The Smooth River Stone is found in Gol Koval in Drustvar. It is used in the creation of a Runic Power Core (1).
Snapping Rockcrawlers are carrion worms summoned by Tamer Korgrul in Rockcrawler Chasm in Highmountain.
Smoldering Inertia is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Smuggled Wildseed is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The Snapped Wand is the sad remains of a Blue Magic Wand handled without care.
Snapfire is a Devastation talent for evokers. It is an exclusive choice node with Raging Inferno.

Snail Rider is a niffen located in Loamm in Zaralek Cavern. She rides a Mammoth Rock Snail that pulls a Hauling Cart behind them. They are travelling to and from the city, via the south-western entrance.
Snailed It concludes the Glimmerogg Racer faction reputation grind, awarding the permanent Big Slick in the City mount.
Snowpaw is Sentinel Sweetspring's saber cat mount and guardian. She can be found resting next to Sentinel Sweetspring at Stars' Rest in Dragonblight.

Snowdrift Plains is a sub-region of Storm Peaks; it can be found at the northwest corner. The plains are filled with Dolomite Giants constantly fighting with Stormforged Raiders and Stormforged Reavers. Bouldercrag's Refuge and Narvir's Cradle are located on the east side near the mountain. Grom'arsh Crash-Site borders it on its southeastern edge.
Soaring Paw is a pandaren flight master located at Eastwind Rest in Kun-Lai Summit.

Sodden Hozen Brawlers are hozen in Trickling Passage in Stormstout Brewery that are apparently controlled by Aqua Dancers by casting on them. Removing the Aqua Dancers removes the ability and makes them damage less.
Snowclaw is a nightsaber located at Starfall Outpost in . It belongs to Delas Moonfang. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, Snowclaw accompanied Delas to Dalaran.

Socrethar's Rise was once a draenei structure taken over by the Sargerei. Ruled by Socrethar and led by Soulbinder Zamaya, they seek to recruit the decedents of the exiled ones and turned them corrupt in the name of the legion. However, forces of the Kirin Tor seek to destroy them from within.
Snowblind Cliffs are cliffs in Highmountain, with a path leading down to Stormheim.

Snowblind is a large, white gryphon found in the Hidden Grove, northeast of Everlook in Winterspring. Hunters that have the secrets of taming Feathermanes can tame her, but destroying a nest is required to coax her. However, she will be highly aggressive.
Snow Orbs are located on the isles of the Island Expeditions.

Soaring Razorwing is a flying razorwing mount reputation award from the Archivists' Codex faction in Korthia. Archivist Roh-Suir sells the mount at (exalted) for 5,000 Cataloged Research.

So Blessed is awarded to players who invest 300 Tower Knowledge into the "Blessing of the Ancients" perk at The Box of Many Things in Torghast, Tower of the Damned. Blessings are (generally) positive powers granted to players in Torghast runs. :
Snowdrift Bracers drop from Drugon the Frostblood in Highmountain.

He was in a gnome-form called Nelson the Nice. He was amongst the nathrezim that returned in World of Warcraft: Shadowlands.

The Sons of Lothar, also known as the Alliance Expedition and the Alliance Expeditionary Force, are mostly the veterans of the Second War that ventured to the orc homeworld of Draenor during the invasion of Draenor, with the goal of confiscating the stolen magical artifacts (such as the Book of Medivh, Eye of Dalaran, etc.) from Ner'zhul and his Horde of Draenor, and to end the threat of the orcs before Ner'zhul could open portals to other worlds. They named themselves Sons of Lothar in honor of Anduin Lothar, who was considered to be the bravest and most selfless human warrior they ever knew. Following his example, they stayed in Draenor, or Outland as it is now called, to safeguard Azeroth

Sol is a lightspawn found located in the Sanctuary of the Light in the Netherlight Temple. To prepare for a demon assault, the priests of the Conclave collected a Spark of Light from Hyrja and empowered it with five Pure Holy Lights, gathered from the holiest places in Azeroth and beyond. With the reagents prepared, the Conclave members and the naaru Saa'ra then created Sol.

Songs of the Alliance are used with Sonic Environment Enhancer. It is created with Inscription (1); taught by Catarina Stanford in Stormwind City.

Sons of Xolotal are blue lightning wolves that can be found just outside of the Den of Xolotal in Zuldazar. They have fought against the Kao-Tien, who appear to have been trying to subjugate their lightning powers for their own uses before being slain by the sons and the Avatar of Xolotal.

Sons of Kor are colossus sons of the Stone Lord, Kor the Immovable. Both he and they can be located within the Shuddering Spires of Deepholm. The Sons are typically fighting rock flayers, but they have also succumbed to the petrifying powers of the basilisks in the northern section of the area. Players typically encounter them after they have attained status with Therazane.

.]] The Soul Pillar (or soul stream) is the name given to the massive stream of souls funneling through central Oribos—from the Crucible at the city's apex and through the Ring of Transference and Ring of Fates—down into the Maw, where it becomes Gorgoa: River of Souls. Normally, jumping into the Soul Pillar from the Ring of Transference takes the player to Ve'nari's Refuge in the Maw. Jumping into the pillar while leveling via The Threads of Fate sends you to Torghast, Tower of the Damned instead.
Soul-Touched Spurs is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

__NOTOC__ Soothoof Hillstriders are goats located in various areas in Highmountain. The ones at the Ettinwalk are actually disguised Mischievous Sprites.

Soul Cyphering was a planned crafting system in the Maw. Stygia (item) and Granule of Stygia would be fashioned into various cyphers; divided into subgroups, that would provide bonuses or ease various actions in the Maw. Many elements of the Evanescent Cyphers would carry directly over to the Anima powers of Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
